title: Self-Pay Price List — Urological Supply Program
content:
Urological Supply Program cash prices and shipping charges, by catheter program.

| Program | Self-pay price per catheter (USD) | Accessory discount for enrolled self-pay patients (percent) | Catheters beyond the monthly limit at self-pay prices | Ground shipping (USD) | Expedited shipping, patient-paid (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351) | 1.45 | 10 | allowed | 0.00 | 14.95 |
| Coudé Tip Intermittent Catheter Program (A4352) | 4.95 | 10 | allowed | 0.00 | 14.95 |
| Closed-System Catheter Program (A4353) | 6.50 | 10 | allowed | 0.00 | 14.95 |
| Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) | 9.75 | 10 | allowed | 0.00 | 14.95 |
| All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344) | 15.50 | 10 | allowed | 0.00 | 14.95 |
| Male External Catheter Program (A4349) | 1.95 | 10 | allowed | 0.00 | 14.95 |

## Price definitions

- **Self-pay price per catheter** — the cash price per catheter on a self-pay line.
- **Accessory discount** — the discount on self-pay accessory items (bags, lubricant, trays, remover) for an enrolled self-pay patient: 10 percent in every program.
- **Catheters beyond the monthly limit** — whether catheters beyond the monthly limit may be bought at self-pay prices: allowed in every program.
- **Ground shipping** — the charge for ground shipping: 0.00 in every program.
- **Expedited shipping** — the patient-paid charge for expedited shipping, never billed to coverage: 14.95 in every program.

## Price comparisons

- The lowest cash price per catheter is the Straight Intermittent program at 1.45 USD; the highest is the All-Silicone Indwelling program at 15.50 USD.
- Ground shipping carries no charge in any program, and expedited shipping costs the patient 14.95 USD in every program.
